purpose: Validate channel surgery, not preserved unpruned-model accuracy
operation: Slice matching gate/up rows and down-projection columns into a smaller dense SiLU MLP
source_weights: Original BF16 weights; converted losslessly to FP64 for the algebra check
reference: Original-width FP64 SiLU MLP with discarded intermediate channels set to zero before down projection
weight_slices: Exact equality to source index_select; separate storage; preserve source values and configuration
native_bf16_check: Finite output, correct output dtype/shape, input preservation and exact weight slices; no assertion of bit-identical output across different GEMM dimensions
scope: Layer-level arithmetic and copy integrity. Does not evaluate full-model quality, speed, checkpoint reload or serving.
